cards.audioTextZh: 什么是管制员 - 飞行员数据链通信（CPDLC）？
cards.referenceText: CPDLC stands for Controller and Pilot Data Link Communication. It is a data link system that allows ATC and pilots to communicate via text messages (instead of voice), including clearances, requests, and reports, supplementing verbal communication to avoid frequency jam and misunderstandings.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是管制员和驾驶员数据链通讯（Controller and Pilot Data Link Communication）的缩写，是一种数据链系统，允许空管和飞行员通过文本报文（而非语音）通信，包括放行指令、请求和报告等，补充语音通信，避免频率拥堵和误解。

cards.audioText: If you have communication failure, how do you use CPDLC on DA-40?
cards.audioTextZh: 若发生通信故障，在 DA - 40 飞机上如何使用管制员 - 飞行员数据链通信（CPDLC）？
cards.referenceText:
Actually, our DA-40 isn’t equipped with CPDLC. I don’t know much about its operation on this aircraft. But in my flight school training, if we encounter communication failure:
First, we follow SOP (Standard Operating Procedures) and complete the applicable checklist to check communication equipment like the earphone, microphone, frequency, etc. Second, we transmit blind on 121.5 MHz and squawk 7600. Finally, if we still lose contact with ATC:.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这道题与CPDLC有关。回答时应说明主要运行考虑因素，识别相关风险，并给出安全、可行的处置思路。具体行动应以飞机检查单、适用程序和实际情况为准。

cards.audioText: Do you have any idea about how we can operate the CPDLC to contact with the ATC or to follow the ATC's instructions when there is a two-way radio failure?
cards.audioTextZh: 当双向无线电发生故障时，我们如何操作CPDLC与空管取得联系或听从空管的指示？
cards.referenceText: First, confirm CPDLC availability. Then, send a text message to ATC indicating two-way radio failure and requesting instructions. Follow ATC’s text clearances via CPDLC, monitor the display closely, and confirm receipt by replying “WILCO”. If CPDLC fails, switch to emergency frequency 121.5 and perform blind transmission.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先确认管制员和驾驶员数据链通讯（CPDLC）可用，然后向空管发送文本报文说明双向无线电失效并请求指令；通过CPDLC遵循空管的文本放行指令，密切监控显示，回复“WILCO”（明白照办）确认接收；若CPDLC失效，切换至应急频率121.5并进行盲目发射。
